subject: Onsite week conflict — propose hyFlex demo & concierge option
messages:
From: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@harringtonhealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Harrington Health Scheduling <scheduling@harringtonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite demo week — initial dates

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for coordinating with us. We are planning the clinical systems team site visit for the week of June 14–18 and would like to schedule a full demo + Q&A while the team is on campus. Our travel team has penciled in June 15 (afternoon) or June 16 (morning) as the best windows.

I've attached a rough site agenda so you can see the blocks we've reserved. Primary attendees: myself, Danny Ortiz (IT Ops), and Dr. Priya Malhotra (Clinical Ops). We may have space for a 60–75 minute deep-dive followed by a 30-minute Q&A.

Can you confirm availability and whether you can bring an SE for the technical deep-dive? Also curious whether you can support a short in-person concierge session (one of our execs likes a hallway walkthrough).

Attachments: Harrington_Site_Agenda.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Thanks,
Emma Shaw
Director of Operations
Harrington Health
emma.shaw@harringtonhealth.com
(415) 555-8124
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@harringtonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo week — initial dates

Hi Emma — great to hear the visit is coming together.

June 15 (afternoon) or June 16 (morning) both work from my side. I can bring Marissa (Solutions Engineer) for the deep technical session — cc'd here. Quick notes:
- We typically do a 60-minute demo + 30-minute technical Q&A. If you want additional time with Marissa for integration details, we can extend by 30 minutes.
- We can provide a concise on-site concierge walkthrough — one of our SEs can spend 20 minutes meeting the exec team on the floor.

If your team has reduced onsite availability (e.g., travel overlaps), we can offer a hyFlex approach: record the deep dive, run a shorter 30-minute in-person highlight, and host a live Q&A that afternoon (or the following week) to include remote participants. I'll attach our current demo slides for reference.

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Tue, June 15 — 1:30pm–3:00pm (deep demo)
- Wed, June 16 — 9:00am–10:30am (deep demo)

If neither is locked, what's your team's preferred window and the exact list of attendees?

Thanks,

— Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0199

Hi Lukas — quick update: we've had a last-minute field event added for several members of the systems team (June 15–16). That squeezes the in-person window more than expected — Dr. Malhotra will still be on-site briefly on the 15th but only for an hour midday. Danny will be in transit both days.

Given that, we'd prefer the hyFlex option you mentioned. Specifically:
- Short on-site highlight for execs (30 min) on June 15 around 12:30pm if possible.
- Full recorded deep-dive that we can view asynchronously — would appreciate detailed notes on the integration bits.
- Live remote Q&A the following Tuesday (June 22) to include several distributed engineers.

Can Marissa or someone create a short run-of-show for the recorded session so our platform team knows what will be covered? Also please confirm if you can do the concierge walkthrough during the 12:30pm slot.

Thanks,
Emma

Emma — thanks for the heads-up. We're happy to pivot to the hyFlex plan. Confirming next steps and a compact run-of-show below so your scheduling team can lock calendars.

Run-of-show (proposed):
- Tue, June 15 — 12:30pm–1:00pm PT: In-person exec highlight + 20-minute concierge walkthrough (onsite). Lukas on-site; Grace O'Connor (SE) to lead concierge.
- Tue, June 15 — 2:00pm PT: Release of recorded deep-dive (60–75 minutes) to Harrington staff via secure link. Includes time-stamped chapters and an integration appendix.
- Tue, June 22 — 10:00am–11:00am PT: Live remote Q&A with Marissa Cole and Grace O'Connor (technical).

Action items: 
1) Marissa: will draft a 1-page run-of-show + integration appendix and upload the recording assets.
2) Grace: confirm concierge availability and travel logistics for June 15 midday.
3) Lukas: will send a HubSpot deal update and share the Drive folder with the recording and slides.

Attachments and links: Demo_Slides-v2.pdf (attached), run-of-show draft (Marissa will add by Fri 5/22), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521, Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDemoAssets

If that schedule works, Emma, I'll ask scheduling to hold the 12:30–1:00pm and the June 22 Q&A. We can tighten the recording delivery timing if your team needs it earlier.

Thanks for flagging the travel change — this hyFlex approach should keep everyone aligned and avoid missing the momentum on the deal.
